strip.label: {count} files of this record, newest first
strip.heldNote: A file with a lock is held: open it to see why.

locked.sheet: Measurement sheet — you cannot open it
locked.sheetWhy: It opens with the right to read measurements (sales.measurements.view); each opening is recorded.

useOn.subtitle: A copy goes there and says where it came from: records of {party}, or of no customer.
useOn.subtitleNone: A copy goes there and says where it came from.
useOn.searchHint: An order, a quote, a request or a style: its number or name (3 characters or more).
useOn.empty: No record of this customer, or of no customer, matches.
useOn.results: Records you can add files to
useOn.shareHint: Only with the chosen record’s own customer; otherwise the office only.
useOn.shareNoRight: Sharing with the customer needs the right to manage files.

refused.otherParty: That record belongs to another customer: a file goes only to a record of the same customer, or to one of no customer.
refused.notFound: The file or the record is out of your reach, or gone.
refused.forbidden: You may not add files to that record, or share them with its customer.
refused.sameRecord: The file is on this record already.
refused.owned: That record keeps its files on its own screen: add the file there.
refused.state: The file is not available any more (held or removed).
refused.network: No answer from the server: nothing was copied. Try again.
refused.failed: The file could not be copied. Try again.

source.hidden: A copy: its source is on a record out of your reach.
source.locked: A copy of a measurement sheet.

sheet.recorded: Measurement sheet: body data — each opening is recorded.

pins.everyone: Pinned for everyone on this record. A pin points at its message; it is never a copy.
pins.removed: Message removed after a privacy request
